15.t: Working with data: testing plastic bags
q: Which plastic broke at the lowest load?
Identify the anomaly and calculate the mean for PP without it.
15 N is anomalous (perhaps a nick in the strip). Mean of 61 and 58 = 59.5 N.
State two variables that must be the same for each strip, and why.
Same width and thickness (and length): a wider or thicker strip is stronger whatever the plastic, so the test would not be fair.
